1.2 Steps required before operation 
 
Observe the following points prior to commissioning: 
 Check all liquid levels, safety devices and covers . 
 Check the tension of the conveyor belt, see "Tensi oning the conveyor belt"  
in the STEINERT NES Operating Instructions. 
 Check that there are no foreign objects on conveyo r belt  
and drive units and remove if necessary. 
 Check the conveyor belt for damage. 
 Check the conveyor belt for off-track running and correct if necessary. 
 Visually inspect the gear unit for leaks. 
 Make sure all protection and safety devices are pr esent, correctly installed  
and functioning. 
 Check all components and screwed connections are t ight. 
 The ambient temperature must meet the manufacturer 's specification, see  
“Technical data”.

pole system speeds.

3.2 Switching on the controller 
 
Switching on the controller 
 
Local:  
Press the "Control On" key (10) 
 
Remote: Hardware signals (HW):  
Set signal "External control On" 
 
Remote: Network (NW):  
Set signal "Control On" 
 
The signals are evaluated by their triggering edge

 Machine movements must be stopped and the power supply switched off as 
fast as possible in case of an emergency. 
 
Shut down in an emergency 
 
 
Proceed as follows in an emergency:  
 
Trigger an EMERGENCY STOP immediately. 
 
Evacuate persons from the danger zone if you are not endangered. 
 
Initiate first aid measures. 
 
Alarm a doctor and the fire brigade. 
 
Inform the person responsible on site. 
 
Switch off the master switch and secure it against switching on. 
 
Keep access paths for emergency vehicles clear. 
After rescue  
Inform responsible authorities if demanded by the severity of the 
emergency. Have specialists eliminate the malfunction. 
 
 
WARNING! 
Danger to life due to premature switching on! 
 
Danger to life for all persons in the danger area due to 
premature switching on. 
 
Therefore: 
 Make sure before switching on that no persons are in 
the danger area.

installed and functioning.
